limits: One fixed prompt/seed, current Ray/text/VAE/LoRA set; not a universal model or hardware speed claim.
All initial requests, ranges and return controls retained. First candidate Native Normal151.229s was slower than the original fork first149.658/149.732s; OS/driver cache coldness was not controlled.

No inference precision, steps, cache, LoRA strengths, user profile or driver/clock changes. Matched pipeline comparisons used common PNG6; the separately measured installed lossless PNG3 change is not added to those timings.
SCALE improvement is small and separate from the whole fork versus official stock; no new LLM/video/CPU-only generation benchmark.

production_api.scope: Real public API5001; Normal then separate4x of the same marked photo. SR is unchanged common media code, not an engine speedup.
